properties.bedrock_type: Carboniferous Sandstone (Craigleith and Hailes strata) interbedded with basaltic volcanic intrusions
properties.stratigraphy: Glacial till boulder clay mantle over consolidated sedimentary sandstone bedrock
properties.drainage: Well-drained sloped northern descent towards the Water of Leith basin

properties.primary_surfacing: Granite whinstone cobbles, hand-dressed Craigleith sandstone kerbs, and stone sett paving
properties.micro_grading: Gentle downward gradient traversing northwest towards Charlotte Square and Queen Street Gardens
properties.wear_patina: Historic cart-wheel polishing on central setts, soot-blackened curbs, damp perimeter gutters

properties.understory: Occasional private mews garden shrubbery and courtyard ivy
properties.groundcover: Urban paved masonry with minimal grass tufts along rear mews stone joints

properties.typology: Edinburgh New Town Georgian Classical Urban Masterplan (James Craig / Robert Adam)

structures.name: St George's Church (West Register House) Dome & Portico
structures.facade_material: Smooth-dressed Craigleith ashlar sandstone with oxidized verdigris copper dome and lead cupola
structures.roof_geometry: Stepped square attic plinth supporting circular peristyle drum, hemispherical copper dome, and lantern
structures.fenestration: Round-arched louvred belfry apertures and monumental classical pilasters

structures.name: Hope Street & Charlotte Square Western Flank Terraces
structures.facade_material: Polished buff Craigleith sandstone ashlar with rusticated ground-floor arcading and droved stone basements
structures.roof_geometry: Mansard and pitched Scotch slate roofs with rhythmic dressed-stone chimney stacks and lead flashings
structures.fenestration: Six-over-six timber sash-and-case windows with crisp orthogonal stone lintels and reveals

structures.name: Corner Pavilions & Hope Lane Mews
structures.facade_material: Random rubble masonry with polished stone quoins, red clay pantiles, and rosemary roof tiles
structures.roof_geometry: Dual-pitched gable roofs punctuated by dormers and industrial-glazed skylights
structures.fenestration: Segmental-arched carriage entrances and small square upper-floor sash windows

properties.fixed_civil_infrastructure: Cast iron Georgian gas lantern posts, stone hitching posts, cast iron basement lightwell railings

properties.sky_condition: Night scene with near-zero solar lux and dark celestial ambient dome
